additions.text: Hi, I would like information about SpanishCue for my school.
A city at night for speaking and listening. The centre is free.
A darkly funny hospital, from A0 to C2. The reception is free.
A fantasy adventure with quests and spells to talk about.
A city overrun by zombies: decide, negotiate and survive in Spanish.
Your students don’t just watch the lesson.
Each world has a Conversation mode and a Listening mode, with separately written levels. The teacher guides from the shared screen.
First understand, then practise, listen, speak and write. Every lesson has a mode for teaching with a teacher and another for students to work on their own.
Hi! I’m Bauti. What would you like to know about SpanishCue for your school?
Hi, I would like information about SpanishCue for my school.
Automatic answers. For your specific case, message us on WhatsApp.
A library of Spanish lessons ready to open on screen: grammar by level, conversation and 3D worlds where students walk around, choose what to say and talk.
How does my team use it?
Each teacher signs in with their own account. From the school dashboard you invite your teachers by email and see who is on your team.
Grammar from A0 to C2, one lesson per level, and conversation with its own levels in each 3D world. A0 includes English support.
How much does it cost for a school?
There is no public institutional price: licences are agreed according to the size of your team. Message us and we will work it out together.
Yes. Noche abierta, the Hospital San Casi Vivo reception and the Clase inicial are free. You can also request a demo for your team.
Hi! I’m Bauti. How can I help you with SpanishCue?
Hi, I have a question about SpanishCue.
Automatic answers. For your specific case, message us on WhatsApp.
Spanish lessons ready to teach: open the lesson, share your screen and teach. Grammar from A0 to C2, conversation and 3D worlds that get your students talking.
What can I try for free?
The centre of Noche abierta, the entrance and reception of Hospital San Casi Vivo, the Clase inicial and Latinoamérica al Oído are free.
US$15.50 a month, final price including taxes. It unlocks the whole library and you can cancel any time before the next renewal.
How do I use it in online lessons?
Open the lesson in your browser and share your screen in Zoom or Meet. Turn on “share sound” so your student hears the audio. Teacher mode saves each student’s progress.
I work at a language school
SpanishCue also offers team licences: each teacher with their own account and a dashboard for the school.
